title: FALL OF BIRA : Why is India's Coolest Beer Brand DYING? : Business case study

👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, Indian beer market ka sirf ek hi Badshah hua karta tha! Is brand ka naam tha Kingfisher. Agar aap 2015 ke market ko dekho, toh top par thi United Breweries, jiska revenue tha ₹4,692 crore. SABMiller India ka revenue tha ₹2,100 crore, aur baaki saare players Kingfisher ke nazdeek bhi nahi the!
Lekin phir 2015 mein market mein ek aisa toofan aaya jisne Kingfisher ki monopoly ko challenge kiya. Is toofan ka naam tha—Bira! Apni branding, taste aur flavours ke dum par Bira ne sirf 8 saalon mein ₹800 crore ka empire khada kar diya, aur dheere-dheere Kingfisher ki monopoly ko dhakka lagne laga. But unfortunately, jis brand ko hum “Future of Beer” maan rahe the, aaj wahi brand ₹749 crore ke bhaari loss mein hai. Kai locations par stock out ho chuka hai, supply chain toot rahi hai, aur Bira aaj khatre mein hai!
Toh sawaal ye hai ki Indian beer market mein tikna itna mushkil kyun hai? Kingfisher jaisi company ko Bira jaisi ek nayi company ne kaise takkar di? Ek badiya product, taste aur popularity ke baad bhi Bira aaj khatre mein kyun hai? Aur most importantly, Bira ki galtiyon se hum kya seekh sakte hain—yeh sab jaanenge is episode mein.
